svg.title: Animated examples for all 22 of OmniRoute's combo routing strategies: priority, fill-first, weighted, round-robin, p2c, least-used, random, strict-random, cost-optimized, headroom, quota-weighted, reset-window, reset-aware, expiry-first, context-relay, context-optimized, cache-optimized, lkgp, auto, fusion, pipeline, jev.
svg.desc: Animated grid of 22 routing-strategy tiles; static tracks show each flow on the first frame while a small dot repeatedly travels the path each strategy takes. Light and dark follow the viewer's color scheme.
svg.text: ● request → ▮ targets — each tile animates the path its strategy takes · green outline = the pick

g.text: stay on T1 until it fails
